question: I shine bright in the sky during the day. What am I?
I come out at night and twinkle. What am I?
I am yellow and grow from the ground. Monkeys love to eat me. What am I?
I am red and round. Doctors say I keep them away. What am I?
I have four legs and bark. I am a pet. What am I?
I meow and like to chase mice. What am I?
I am white and fall from the sky when it's cold. What am I?
I am wet and fall from clouds. What am I?
I have wings and can fly. I tweet and sing. What am I?
I am round and you kick me in sports. What am I?
I have wheels and you ride me. What am I?
I tell you the time. I have hands but no arms. What am I?
I am sweet and brown. Bees make me. What am I?
I am cold and you lick me. I melt in the sun. What am I?
I am green and hop. I say ribbit. What am I?
I am big and gray with a long trunk. What am I?
I swim in water and have fins. What am I?
I am tall and green. I grow in the forest. What am I?
I smell nice and have colorful petals. Bees visit me. What am I?
I light up the night sky. I am round and bright. What am I?
